summary_1line: Satyaki battles Karna and Kaurava warriors at night as Arjuna’s devastating advance alarms them, prompting a plan to surround and kill Satyaki and Dhrishtadyumna.

image_candidates.scene_text: Satyaki and Karna stand on their chariots in a night battle, loosing storms of arrows as sparks flash and armies surround them.
Vrishasena, struck in the chest by Satyaki’s arrow, collapses onto his chariot while Karna watches in sudden grief and rage.
In the dark battlefield, warriors pause as the thunderous twang of Arjuna’s Gandiva echoes over drums, cries, and fleeing soldiers.
